description: Traffic Cameras is a dataset listed in City of Toronto open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by City of Toronto. The Traffic Camera dataset contains the location and number for every Traffic camera in the City of Toronto. These datasets will be updated within 2 minutes when cameras are added, changed, or removed. The camera list files can be found at: tmcearthcameras.csv - CSV, camera list in CSV tmcearthcameras.json - json formatted list. Coverage: Toronto. The portal files it under the publisher City of Toronto. Its tags are traffic camera. It offers 9 resource(s) in CSV, GEOJSON, GPKG, SHP. The portal shows 2026-02-20 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-toronto-portal.
